root_cause: Fee schedule misconfiguration applying MDR to fee‑free RuPay credit UPI transactions.
diagnosis: The gateway/acquirer is charging a standard fee (e.g., Rs 13‑27) on RuPay credit UPI payments that should incur zero fee, indicating an incorrect fee mapping.
action_rationale: Auditing the gateway's fee configuration will identify and correct the erroneous fee rule causing the overcharges.
